scope: Optional VQF phrase factoring on the native lexical-index artifact. Fast remains the unfactored Phase 8 layout. Balanced and max may emit flag 0x01 phrase streams when they strictly reduce the complete artifact. Ratios compare factored artifact bytes with the unfactored fast artifact.
methodology: Three warmups and 100 sequential max-profile encode/decode samples per corpus. Decode includes deterministic re-encoding validation. Query scores for fast, balanced and max are compared against ordinary V4 on the same pack.
